title: Pedritxes
thumbnail_desc: Study for the a full renovation of a villa in Matadepera.
description: Pedritxes is a Catalan term that refers to the small stone or concrete upstands, or low plinths, found at the base of a wall, façade, or structure. Coincidentally, it is also the name of the street. When viewed from the outside, the villa reads almost like a single large stone emerging from the ground, which made it feel natural—and amusing—to name the project after the street itself.
